property_summary: Only the admin (deployer) can successfully change owner via setOwner; the mutant removes that restriction allowing non-admin callers to change owner (so there exists some caller/address for which setOwner succeeds on mutant but would be rejected on the reference).
change_summary: Relaxed the onlyAdmin check to allow any caller (removed require), so setOwner's access control is bypassed and behavior visible: non-admin can set owner.
